title: CRO audit: valentinyeo.com

overall.result: The home page sells well; the case study and contact pages give a convinced reader no way to book, and the booking click is not measured.
overall.next: Add the teardown button to the case-study and contact pages, then add a click event on the cal.com links.

audit.result: Score 64/100 (Moderate): strong home page, weak path after it.
audit.confidence: Medium: 3 pages, lab data only, baseline assumed
found: Case studies end with no way to book (High)
Contact page has no booking path (High)
Only 1 of 5 case-study tests reports a result (High)
Teardown not explained next to the button (Medium)

speed.result: Pages are light and fast in lab tests (LCP 1.0-1.7 s, 26-34 KB); speed is not the problem.
speed.confidence: Low-medium: single lab runs, no real-user data
found: Case study LCP 1.7 s (slower server response)

tracking.result: Only page views are measured; no event on the teardown button.
tracking.confidence: High for what fires, none for what happens inside cal.com
found: Endless Testing SDK on home and contact with no test configured

readiness.result: Not testable on the assumed baseline: no A/B test can reach a result.
found: Smallest detectable lift 320% in 4 weeks, 201% in 8 weeks

personas.result: Both visitors reached the booking calendar; neither booked.
score: 2 of 2 reached the calendar, 0 of 2 booked (simulated visitors)
found: P1: hesitated on proof and price; inner pages felt like a different site
P2: unsure who the service is for; 'teardown' is jargon

skeptic.result: 3 candidate findings rejected, 5 downgraded, 8 reworded before reaching the report.
found: Eduki and trivago links work (finding dropped)
Duplicate CSS and layout-shift findings dropped

verify: Compare teardown clicks and bookings for 4 weeks after the fixes against 4 weeks before
Five moderated sessions with target buyers
Clarity recordings of sessions reaching the case study or contact page
